title: sebastiania glandulosa

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
